query:
UPDATE measurement_point_defs mpd 
SET `workstation_id` = (
  SELECT id FROM workstations 
  WHERE code = CASE MOD(mpd.id, 10)
    WHEN 0 THEN 'QC-01'
    WHEN 1 THEN 'SMT-01'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'SMT-02'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'DIP-01'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'ASM-01'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'SOL-01'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'TEST-01'
    WHEN 7 THEN 'BURN-01'
    WHEN 8 THEN 'INS-01'
    ELSE 'PKG-01'
  END
  LIMIT 1
)
